summary: 8.5, level with w19 (B 8.5, A 8.6). No high or medium issue is open. Geometry is unchanged: all eight studio views p1-p8 are pixel-identical to w19 (0 changed px). In q13 and q14 the luminance changes (|dL| > 15) are confined to the window reveals, the sidewall and the window-lit far seat (q13: 3,479 px, 85 % at x < 300 and y 150-300; q14: far-seat back -10 L, window reveal -12 L). Silhouette, shell, headrest ears, console and the q13 row pitch read exactly as rated in w19. The w18 cord stays fixed. On the q14 near seat the bead is at the same x in every sampled row, and its min L moved by only 0-2 (rows 190-550: 51-56 at the top, 29-42 low down; w19 53-58 / 30-44). The head lighting adds a cool white balance. Fabric B-R rises from 31 to 44 at an unchanged L of 125 (q14 back), and from 35 to 47 in q13. Shell B-R rises from 20 to 27, and the q14 sidewall from 1 to 20. The official photos are cool too (py_37301 wall B-R 25-27, fabric 33-37 at L 154). So the scene now matches the photo's white balance, and scene-relative fabric blueness has dropped (fabric minus wall: w19 30, head 24, photo 10). In absolute terms, though, the fabric chroma per unit L is now 0.35 against the photo's 0.24 (w19 0.25), so the seats read slightly more periwinkle than the photo's blue-grey. That is low severity and mainly the lighting's doing. Fabric contrast is unchanged (L sd 32 against the photo's 38-54; thin-dark 1.78 % against 1.83 % in w19). The w17 / w15 low carry-overs remain, so the score stays at 8.5.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) The new mood has a cool white balance (sidewall B-R 1 -> 20). That matches the photos' walls (B-R 25-27), but it pushes the already blue fabric to B-R/L 0.35 against the photo's 0.24. If the lighting owner keeps the cool balance, desaturate PYFAB by about 25 % or warm it slightly to stay on the photo. (2) The bright diamond-shaped sun patch on the window-seat back in q14 (x 485-550, y 300-420, L 179) has no counterpart in py_37301 / 37303, whose seats are evenly lit. (3) Overall the render is darker than the photos (fabric L 125 against 154), so the fabric looks a step darker and lower in contrast than the photo. (4) The bead still depends on crevice AO (L 29-42 low on the q14 near seat).
